feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 10:55pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system crossing the south of the Irish Sea overnight, very weak ridge of high pressure follows later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 occasionally 5, then backing south or southwest 3 or 4 later tomorrow afternoon. Then becoming east 5 or 6 end of the period.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, decreasing slight overnight.


##Weather##

Rain for a time in the south of the area overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 5 or 6 early tomorrow night, then north or northwest 5 to 7 by dawn Friday. Increasing Northwest 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8 on Friday morning. Then decreasing west or northwest 5 or 6 early Friday night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Heavy rain soon arriving, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming good later.
